description: Fix 5 issues from semantic review: (1) state dots render as squares due to borderRadius.full override, (2) multiple filled blocks on host queue, (3) hover:bg-live-wash violates style guide, (4) Toast type prop dead code, (5) RequestQueue NEW rows missing border-b separator.
steps: Fix tailwind.config.ts borderRadius.full to '9999px' so rounded-full works for 6px state dots
Fix RequestQueue.tsx to only fill the most recent/top NEW request with bg-live; remaining NEW requests get border-l-[1.5px] border-live treatment
Fix RequestViews.tsx to only fill the most recent/top NEW request with bg-live; remaining NEW requests get border-l-[1.5px] border-live treatment
Remove hover:bg-live-wash from src/app/page.tsx, src/app/party/[guestCode]/page.tsx, and src/app/host/[hostCode]/page.tsx
Remove type prop from Toast interface and destructuring, remove type='info' from host dashboard call site
Add border-b border-white/20 to filled NEW rows in RequestQueue for visual separation
acceptance_criteria: Only the most recent NEW request per screen gets bg-live fill
No hover:bg-live-wash anywhere in the codebase
Toast component has no type prop in interface or parameters
Adjacent NEW rows in RequestQueue have visible separators
findings: All acceptance criteria met: rounded-full = 9999px, only newest NEW request per screen gets bg-live, no hover:bg-live-wash anywhere, Toast has no type prop, adjacent NEW rows have separators. Build and all 53 tests pass.
